title: 第13章 东窗事发第14章 人美心善的大师姐
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
“苏凡师弟，以后还请多多关照。”
“苏师弟威武霸气。”
“师弟，方便透露一下，你修炼的技巧是什么？如何做到半个月连破两境？”
薛长山和许三阴一走，四周的弟子就活跃起来，把苏凡围得是水泄不通，态度一百八十度大转变。
带着讨好的意味。
“技巧？”
苏凡呲牙一笑，很欠揍的说：“当然要有过人的修炼天赋，不然就算再努力也是白搭。”
大家黑着脸。
你一个废灵体，能不能别老是谈修炼天赋？
论天赋，在场的人，哪个不是百分百的碾压你？
“废灵体就是废物？”
“你们的思想，也太狭隘。”
“看看我，就是一个让你们望尘莫及的妖孽天才。”
苏凡哈哈大笑。
众人青筋暴跳，好想揍这混蛋一顿，实在太不要脸。
但没人敢动手。
毕竟冷月就站在一旁。
这位第十峰的大师姐，可是拓脉期的修者，凭一人之力，便足以横扫全场。
不过。
别人不敢，冷月敢。

见苏凡都快忘乎所以，当即不由抬手，狠狠敲向苏凡的脑门。
“大师姐，我是伤员。”
苏凡揉着脑门，委屈巴巴。
冷月白了眼他，朝那胖子走去。
“暴力女魔头。”
苏凡不满的咕哝一句，低头看向肩上的血窟窿。
疗伤丹果然不凡，这么大一个伤口，现在已经止血，但要彻底治愈，至少得要好几天。
“赵宇是吧！”
“等着瞧，早晚弄死你。”
苏凡抬头看了眼第一峰，眼中闪过一抹寒光，便朝冷月追去。
站在赌桌前的胖子，敬畏的看着冷月，谄笑道：“师姐，灵石已经准备好，一赔十，总共十万，你清点一下。”
大家围过来，看着堆积如小山般的灵石，羡慕嫉妒恨。
太没眼力劲。
之前就应该押苏凡，险中求富贵。
如这胖子，本以为他这次坐庄，连裤衩都会赔掉，可不曾想，结果是大赚特赚。
因为除开冷月，全是押徐娇娇赢。
现在徐娇娇败给苏凡，那这些灵石，就全归胖子这个庄家，可谓是一夜暴富。
苏凡嘿嘿笑道：“以后再有这样的赌局，知道怎么押了吧！”
大家相视苦笑。
今后哪还有这么好的机会？因为都已经知道苏凡的实力。

冷月也没清点，直接装进储物袋。
毕竟十万灵石不是一个小数目，要是一一清点，估计得清点到大半夜。
至于数目。
content_en:
"Junior Brother Su Fan, please take good care of me in the future."
"Junior Brother Su is mighty and domineering."
"Junior brother, could you please tell me what your training skills are? How do you break through two levels in a row in half a month?"
As soon as Xue Changshan and Xu Sanyin left, the disciples around him became active and surrounded Su Fan. His attitude changed completely.
With a flattering tone.
"Technique?"
Su Fan grinned and said, "Of course you must have extraordinary talent for cultivation, otherwise no matter how hard you try, it will be in vain."
Everyone had a dark face.
You are a useless spirit, can you stop talking about cultivation talents all the time?
In terms of talent, who among the people present would not 100% crush you?
"A waste spirit is waste?"
"Your thinking is too narrow-minded."
"Look at me, I am a monster genius that you can't even catch up to."
Su Fan laughed.
Everyone's veins were bulging, they really wanted to beat this bastard, it was so shameless.
But no one dared to take action.
After all, Leng Yue was standing aside.
This senior sister of the Tenth Peak is a cultivator in the pulse-expanding stage. She can sweep the entire field with just one person.
but.
Others dare not, but Leng Yue dares.
Seeing that Su Fan was almost forgetful, he immediately raised his hand and knocked hard on Su Fan's forehead.
"Sister, I am a wounded person."
Su Fan rubbed his forehead, feeling aggrieved.
Leng Yue rolled her eyes at him and walked towards the fat man.
"The violent devil."
Su Fan muttered dissatisfiedly and looked down at the bloody hole on his shoulder.
The healing pill is indeed extraordinary. Such a large wound has stopped bleeding now, but it will take at least several days to completely heal.
"Zhao Yu, right?"
"We'll see, I'll kill you sooner or later."
Su Fan raised his head and glanced at the first peak, a cold light flashed in his eyes, and he chased Leng Yue.
The fat man standing in front of the gambling table looked at Leng Yue in awe, and said with a flattering smile: "Senior sister, the spirit stones are ready. The compensation is ten, and the total is one hundred thousand. You can count it."
Everyone gathered around and looked at the mountains of spiritual stones, feeling envious and jealous.
Too unsightly.
Su Fan should have been taken into custody before, seeking wealth from danger.
This fat man, for example, thought that he would lose even his underwear if he took the banker this time, but he never thought that he would make a lot of money in the end.
Because except for Leng Yue, everyone was betting on Xu Jiaojiao to win.
Now that Xu Jiaojiao lost to Su Fan, all these spiritual stones would belong to the banker, Fatty, who could be said to have become rich overnight.
Su Fan chuckled and said: "If there is such a bet again in the future, you should know how to bet!"
Everyone looked at each other and smiled bitterly.
Where will there be such a good opportunity in the future? Because everyone already knows Su Fan's strength.
Leng Yue didn’t take any inventory and put it directly into the storage bag.
After all, one hundred thousand spirit stones is not a small amount. If they were to be counted one by one, it would probably take until midnight.
As for the number.
